Kelsey (People Ops): Quick drop — assembled a tiny paste-ready set of manager/IC lines for OKRs + self-reviews. Use in 1:1s or when coaching someone through a draft.

Kelsey (People Ops): Manager framing — helpful 1‑liners to get a better self-review:
• "Help me hear one thing you're proud of and one clear gap you want to close." 
• "What metric or signal would convince you the work moved the needle?"
• "Tell me how you partnered/crossed teams — one concrete example." 
• "If you had more time, what's one thing you'd iterate on and why?"

Kelsey (People Ops): IC-friendly sample phrasing for accomplishments:
• "Led X feature launch, reduced median latency from 420ms→260ms (p50→p50)."
• "Built a small test harness that cut triage time by ~30% for flaky jobs."

Kelsey (People Ops): Manager/lead sample phrasing for impact & coaching:
• "Coached 2 engineers to own production incidents end-to-end; adoption of playbook → 3/4 fewer escalations."
• "Set clearer goals for the team; unblocked cross-team dependency with weekly syncs."

Alex Rivera: Love this. Quick ask — can we add a one-liner for 'stretch goal' framing? e.g., "Ambitious, measurable target we'll only hit with stretch effort; expected upside X."

Maria Chen: For ICs vs managers, maybe add examples for individual contributor growth vs team outcomes. Small tweak: replace 'we' with 'I' in IC examples.

Jamal Patel: Quick Q — peer feedback anonymity guidance? Some folks paste peer quotes into their draft, we want to avoid re-attribution.

HR Bot: FYI — peer feedback guidance: keep quotes anonymized unless explicit permission. See https://internal.redwood/hr/peer-feedback-policy :eyes:

Kelsey (People Ops): Good call Jamal — will add an 'anonymize quotes' reminder and a tiny checkbox template. I'll drop a short doc and pin it in #people-ops.

Alex Rivera: +1. Also can we add a 2‑sentence opener managers can paste at the top of a review to set tone? Something like: "This review is a snapshot to help your growth. Focus on concrete examples and outcomes — we'll discuss and iterate." 

Kelsey (People Ops): Done — will add that and share an editable Google Doc after lunch. Thanks all :raised_hands:

HR Bot: Document created: https://docs.google.com/xyz (access: people-ops) :white_check_mark:
